g.text: Split each Q, K, V into 12 heads
12 layers | hidden size 768 | 12 attention heads | head dimension 64 | FFN width 3072
B: batch size; L: sequence length (≤ 512); M: additive padding mask. Dropout is omitted in evaluation mode.
Attention matrices illustrate the mathematics; an optimized SDPA implementation need not explicitly materialize them.
